_comment: Every Python runtime archive the site must keep serving, and which
Each released app embeds an immutable URL and SHA-256 in its own
python-pin.json. Publication used to stage only the runtime for the app
being published and then exchange the whole of html/, so shipping a new
payload took the old one off the site: an app that had not yet fetched an
interpreter got a 404, or -- for a same-version re-sign -- bytes whose
hash it refuses. Older payloads survived in .previous-* backups but were
no longer served at the URLs older apps ask for.
So retention is declared here and merged additively at deploy time. A
registered path may never acquire different bytes; retirement is a
deliberate later decision, not a side effect of shipping.
path is a bare filename, never a URL or a path with separators. Future
entries use ClickGraft-python-<version>-<sha256>.zip; the legacy name is
accepted exactly as it is, because 1.8.0 and 1.8.1 embed it.
